title: Deposit
body_md: A non-refundable deposit of 50% of your quote total confirms your date. After you accept a quote, your date is held for 48 hours; holds without a deposit are released automatically.

title: Balance
body_md: The remaining balance is due 7 days before your event, by Interac e-Transfer.

title: Cancellation
body_md: Your deposit is non-refundable. Cancellation terms closer to the event date will be confirmed in your quote.

title: Rescheduling
body_md: One free reschedule within 12 months, subject to availability.

title: Weather (outdoor sessions & minis)
body_md: If we cancel an outdoor session or mini session because of weather, we will reschedule at no cost.

title: Damage & rental care
body_md: You are responsible for damage to rented items beyond normal wear and tear.

title: Prints & deliverables
body_md:
Your edited digital photos are delivered through an online gallery and are included: we deliver all the good ones, so there is no selection round. Delivery is 2 to 3 weeks after your event (wedding photography: 3 weeks; birthdays: 2 weeks). Printed photos and albums are available as add-ons.

With your permission we may share a small selection (about 5 to 20 photos) on the FMV Facebook page. This is optional: just tell us if you would rather we did not.

title: Travel
body_md: Travel is included within Fredericton. Outside Fredericton a travel charge of $0.50 per km applies. Photo booth rentals include delivery within 30 km. Any travel charge is shown in your quote.

title: Privacy
body_md: We collect your name, contact details and event details only to quote, book and deliver your event, and keep them for as long as needed for that and for our records. To ask for a copy or deletion of your information, contact us.
